correctness.rationale: An explicit induction proves exactly T_j singleton and complementary uniform point classes at round 2j; any line with two old singleton endpoints becomes a singleton one round later. Binary symmetric difference proves T_j+T_j=T_(j+1) including the old T_j. The surviving all-ones vector may itself be the unique residual point, producing the sharp 2 ceil(log2(d-1)) bound. The final-stage line proof checks all dimension ranges and supplies two distinct same-coloured lines when d>2^(k-1)+2. Nontrivial linear shears fixing any proper marked span establish the minimum d. The direct checker passed d=2..9; independent incidence-signature and late-collision checker passed d=2..17 as recorded. No infinite claim rests on finite tests.

value.rationale: Individualization-versus-refinement is a motivated finite-model-theory problem. The theorem gives the exact minimal point landmarks, an all-round partition, the sharp logarithmic parallel-closure rate, and a discontinuous last-step phenomenon for unbounded point--line incidence graphs. These are explicit nontrivial classification and sharp-depth answers, not a generic closure identity or unmotivated finite census.
